messages.content: 誰是英超聯賽中最多助攻的球員？

function.name: sports_analysis_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieves the player with most goals in a specific football league Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league.description: The football league name. Eg. Premier League

season.description: The season in format yyyy/yyyy. Eg. 2020/2021

team.description: Optionally the specific team to consider. Eg. Liverpool

message.content: 截至目前（2025 年），英超歷史上助攻數量最多的球員是 **凱文·德布勞內（Kevin De Bruyne）**，他在曼城效力期間已累積超過 140 次助攻，保持著單一球員助攻紀錄。
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "誰是英超聯賽中最多助攻的球員？" which translates to "Who is the player with the most assists in the English Premier League?" They want the top assist provider in the Premier League. We need to answer. According to current data up to 2025? Actually as of 2023-24 season, the all-time record for assists in the Premier League is Kevin De Bruyne (with 140+). But the question might refer to the current season's top assist provider. The user didn't specify season. So we can provide the all-time record holder: Kevin De Bruyne. Or we could ask clarifying question. But likely they want the all-time record. Provide answer: Kevin De Bruyne holds the record for most assists in Premier League history.

We should respond in Chinese.
